description: This Python source file defines a SoundfileMixer class that extends BaseAudioMixer to provide an audio mixing functionality using sound files. It supports loading multiple sound files, updating settings at runtime, and mixing audio streams with support for looping and volume control.

classes.name: SoundfileMixer
classes.description: An audio mixer class that combines incoming audio with sound files loaded from disk, supporting runtime updates and looping.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the SoundfileMixer with sound files, default sound, volume, and looping options.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Loads all sound files asynchronously at the given sample rate.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Placeholder for cleanup; currently does nothing.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes control frames to update settings or enable/disable mixing.

methods.name: mix
methods.description: Mixes incoming audio bytes with the current sound file.

methods.name: _update_settings
methods.description: Updates mixer settings such as sound, volume, and loop based on control frames.

methods.name: _change_sound
methods.description: Changes the current sound file being played.

methods.name: _update_volume
methods.description: Updates the volume level for mixing.

methods.name: _load_sound_file
methods.description: Loads a sound file into memory for later mixing.

methods.name: _mix_with_sound
methods.description: Performs the actual mixing of raw audio with the loaded sound file.
